title: Heated Pool | Hot Tub | Pool Table | Game Room
description:
🌴 The Grove – Spacious Family Retreat with Heated Pool, Game Room & Resort-Style Backyard

Looking for a place that keeps everyone happy — from toddlers to teens to grandparents?
Welcome to The Grove, a 5-bedroom Mesa oasis with a heated pool, game room, luxury kitchen, and backyard that feels like your own private resort. Perfect for multi-generational families, friend groups, or anyone looking for space to reconnect and relax.

 The space 
✔️ Sleeps up to 14 comfortably
✔️ Heated pool & oversized hot tub (included in price)
✔️ Huge backyard with putting green, outdoor kitchen, fire pit & yard games
✔️ Basement game room with pool table, darts, smart TV
✔️ Fully stocked kitchen perfect for family meals
✔️ Thoughtful touches, luxury beds, and incredible hosts

🛏️ 5 Bedrooms – Sleep Like Royalty
✔️ Primary Suite: King bed, ensuite bathroom, workspace + cozy window nook
✔️ Bedroom 2: Queen bed
✔️ Bedroom 3: Queen bed
✔️ Bedroom 4: King bed
✔️ Bedroom 5: Double-over-double bunk bed with secret tunnel (kids LOVE this!)

All bedrooms include:
✔️ Premium linens & pillows
✔️ Smart TVs
✔️ Nightstands, reading lamps, full closets
✔️ Room-darkening curtains for better sleep

🍽 Fully Stocked Kitchen & Dining Area
✔️ Quartz countertops, large island, double oven & air fryer
✔️ Keurig & drip coffee maker
✔️ Toaster, blender, microwave, cookware, spices, and oils
✔️ Seating for 12 at the dining table + 2 at the island
✔️ Outdoor kitchen with BBQ, sink, and bar seating

Our guests say it best:

“Our son is a chef… he prepared meals for the whole group and had everything he needed!” – Kristin

🌴 Backyard Paradise – Your Private Resort
✔️ Heated pool (no extra charge!) with pool toys
✔️ Oversized hot tub with room for the whole crew
✔️ Outdoor dining for 10 + fire pit lounge area
✔️ Covered patio with fireplace
✔️ Putting green, Connect 4, cornhole, mini golf
✔️ Lush landscaping + orange trees for fresh juice

From morning swims to s’mores under the stars, this yard delivers family fun and unforgettable evenings.

🎯 Game Room + Entertainment Zone
✔️ Pool table
✔️ Dart board
✔️ Record player & bar with mini fridge
✔️ Comfy sectional and Smart TV
✔️ Great hangout space for teens or late-night game tournaments

🧼 Clean, Comfortable, and Thoughtfully Designed
✔️ Spotless bathrooms with walk-in showers & bathtubs
✔️ Double vanities, plush towels, and hairdryers
✔️ In-unit laundry with washer/dryer, iron & board
✔️ Central A/C & heating
✔️ Free parking in quiet neighborhood

📍 Prime Location
✔️ 20–25 mins to Scottsdale
✔️ Minutes to groceries, restaurants, and parks
✔️ Easy access to Phoenix, Tempe, hiking trails & wedding venues
✔️ Quiet, safe, family-friendly neighborhood

❤️ Why Guests Love The Grove
“Felt like a private resort.” – Mike
“Everyone had their own favorite space, and we loved coming together around the pool, fire pit, and kitchen.” – Heather
“Even better than the photos. Beds felt like a luxury hotel. Backyard was magical!” – Emily
“Every detail was thought of. The most well-stocked Airbnb we’ve stayed in.” – Karen

📝 Important Details
✔️ No pets, no smoking indoors
✔️ No parties or events
✔️ High-speed Wi-Fi for work or school needs
✔️ Quiet hours 10pm–7am to respect neighbors

This is a family-centered home — perfect for reunions, staycations, milestone birthdays, or just a break from the noise.

🗓 Ready to Book?
The Grove is one of Mesa’s highest-rated homes for families and group getaways.
Check availability, message with questions, or lock in your next unforgettable escape.
✔️ Longer stays welcome
✔️ No extra charge for pool heat
✔️ Ultra-responsive hosting from booking to checkout

 Guest access 
The house is exclusively yours, without interruption for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home. 

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home also comes with the following:

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Laundry Room (Washer/Dryer, Iron/Board, Sink)
✔ Free Parking

 Other things to note 
★ ADDITIONAL ACCOMMODATION ★
Traveling in a larger group, or your preferred dates are already taken? You'll be happy to know that we offer additional accommodation in the area. Please browse our host profile for the complete list of gorgeous listings.

★ CLEANING & SANITIZATION ★
Heath, safety, and well-being of our guests are of utmost importance. For this reason, we use a thorough cleaning process after each check-out.

★ NO PETS ALLOWED ★
We love those little (and not so little) furry bundles of joy. Sadly, our home is not suitable to accommodate them.

★ NO SMOKING INSIDE ★
Please refrain from smoking inside the home! Any smoking evidence will result in a fee for odor removal and furniture cleaning.

★ NO PARTIES/EVENTS ★
We kindly ask you to treat our home as your own to preserve its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits.

Thank you very much for your understanding.
